title: Blue Jays claim Cairo off waivers, designate Lee for assignment
text:
Blue Jays claim Cairo off waivers, designate Lee for assignment - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Blue Jays claim Cairo off waivers, designate Lee for assignment
 Sportsnet Staff @Sportsnet November 19, 2026 - 4:53pm Toronto Blue Jays pitcher Chase Lee throws the ball to first baseman Sean Keys in time to get New York Yankees' Ryan McMahon out during the fourth inning of a spring training baseball game Wednesday, March 11, 2026, in Tampa, Fla. (Chris O'Meara/AP) 
 The Toronto Blue Jays continued to shuffle the margins of their 40-man roster on Thursday.
 The Blue Jays claimed infielder Christian Cairo off waivers from the Los Angeles Dodgers and designated reliever Chase Lee for assignment in a corresponding move, the team announced. 
 Cairo, 25, has yet to make his MLB debut but slashed .230/.381/.300 with four home runs, 36 RBIs and 25 stolen bases across 130 games at triple-A last season.
 He split the season between the Philadelphia Phillies and New York Mets systems and was just claimed off waivers by the Dodgers on Nov. 9. 
 Meanwhile, Lee pitched in eight games for the Blue Jays in 2026, logging a 6.52 ERA with five strikeouts and eight walks over 9.2 innings. 
 The other 29 MLB teams will now have seven days to trade for or claim Lee before he passes through waivers and is assigned to the Blue Jays' minor league system. 
 Toronto's 40-man roster is full after Nolan Perry, Daniel Guerra and RJ Schreck were selected for protection from the Rule 5 draft on Tuesday.
